fields.System.Title: CNT-302 — Require a recount above threshold
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want large variances counted a second time before anything
is adjusted, so that we do not correct correct data because of one miscount.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a variance above the configured quantity or value threshold, then a recount task
  • is created and no adjustment is posted yet.
  • - Given the recount, then it is compared against the original snapshot, not against
  • any adjusted figure.
  • - Given the recount agrees with the first count, then the variance proceeds to approval.
  • - Given the recount differs from the first count, then a third count or supervisor
  • escalation is required.
  • - Given the recount, then it is assigned to a different person where staffing allows.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | counting |
| Tables | count_task, variance |
| Risks | Recount against the adjusted figure hides the problem ([doc 09 §6.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
